questions.q: Which suppliers deliver products stored in the Chennai warehouse?
questions.answer: Bluepeak Textiles, Kaveri Packaging, Suvarna Foods, Orion Components
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[r:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:STORED_IN]->(w:Warehouse {city: 'Chennai'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS supplier

questions.q: Which of those have a rating below 4?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[r:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:STORED_IN]->(w:Warehouse {city: 'Chennai'}) WHERE s.name IN ['Bluepeak Textiles', 'Kaveri Packaging', 'Suvarna Foods', 'Orion Components'] AND s.rating < 4 RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS supplier

questions.q: Which customer ordered the largest total quantity?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[_r1:CONTAINS]->(p:Product) WHERE p.sku = 'SKU-10047' WITH c, sum(_r1.qty) AS total ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN c.name AS customer

questions.q: What is the standard return window?
questions.answer: The standard return window is 30 days, as stated in [1] section 1 of the returns policy document.

questions.q: What is the restocking fee for electronics?
questions.answer: The restocking fee for electronics is 12% of the item price. This information can be found in [1] under Category rules for the Electronics category section, which states "Electronics - 12% of item price".

questions.q: What are the vendor payment terms?
questions.answer: Payment is due on net 45 day terms from the date a correct invoice is received. Early payment at a 1.5% discount is available for invoices paid within 10 days.

questions.q: What is the late delivery penalty?
questions.expected: 2% of PO value per week of delay, capped at 10%
questions.answer: Late deliveries attract a penalty of 2% of the purchase order value for each week of delay, capped at 10% of the purchase order value. [1]

questions.q: What temperature must the Chennai cold room be kept at?
questions.answer: The Chennai cold room must be held between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.

questions.q: What are the inbound dock hours?
questions.answer: Inbound docks are open from 06:00 to 14:00, Monday to Saturday.
